notes: The list marks Hoth: Echo Command Center (War Room) '(start)', but the post opens '***Typo in deck, i start throne room in this deck' and its Start section lists Throne Room, Strike Planning, Insurrection, Staging Areas and Heading For Medical Frigate, so Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room is the starting location. No Objective; with several starting Effects, no single starting Effect is named.
Interrupts header says 19 but 18 are listed; total 60 as published.

Posted 'Han w/ Gun' dested Han With Heavy Blaster Pistol; 'Leia w/ Gun' Leia With Blaster Rifle; 'Luke w/ Saber' Luke With Lightsaber; 'Obi w/ Saber' Obi-Wan With Lightsaber; 'Major Hasshn' Major Haash'n; 'Lietenant Blount' Lieutenant Blount; 'Endor Landing Platform' Endor: Landing Platform (Docking Bay); 'Home One DB' Home One: Docking Bay; 'Hoth Echo DB' Hoth: Echo Docking Bay.

Posted 'Do, or Do Not/Wise Advise' dested the Reflections II combo Do, Or Do Not & Wise Advice; 'Shocking Info & Grimtash' Shocking Information & Grimtaash; 'Houjx & Out of Nowhere' Houjix & Out Of Nowhere. Battle Plan, Your Insight Serves You Well, Ounee Ta and Aim High are the 2001 Effects (not the Reflections III shields).
Played by Chris Praskac and 'Tj' (credited to the poster, Chris Praskac).
player_note: The post says: 'This deck was played by Tj & I day one of Normal.  I didn't lose with it and won Tj free entry into the DPC tourney.' (posted 27 February 2001; title 'Shopping Cart Barrier (DPC WINNING Day 1)').
